method: Merged rule set: same immutable source/fixture copies, wave31 exact local predecessor, independent cold copies per executable. External control disables batching, concurrency, advisory/report reuse and asset-byte cache. Literal decision IDs, witness IDs, tiers, exits, notes and FIX identities; raw full decision payload separately checked without normalization. Fixture-constructor representation remains optimized in both and has focused isolation/page-size/captured-authority tests.
